title: Lunamachi (月街) — a cozy browser room where ~100 little pixel beings live to lo-fi music
author: jin_sprited
selftext:
Hi, I'm trying out bunch of concepts for a **cozy space** where people can just come and listen to lo-fi music without worrying about ads. It is quite a bit rough but I wanted to see if there would be any interest in this kind of product. 

**Should I fold or continue with the concept?**

Disclosure: This demo was made in a single day and animated characters were generated by SpriteDX. Music was created using Suno AI.

comments.author: flaminghotcola
comments.body:
I’d like to try it. I would add some backgrounds you can choose from to make it cozy.  
Is there a way to try it?

replies.author: jin_sprited
replies.body: Thanks, you can try it out here: You can try out a prototype here: [https://lunamachi.sprited.ai/](https://lunamachi.sprited.ai/)

replies.author: flaminghotcola
replies.body: It’s very cute. Allow us to have a character customizatier etc would be great

replies.author: jin_sprited
replies.body: Thanks u/flaminghotcola, that would be great! It would allow people to generate characters on the fly right on the web.
